name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A plugin that upgrades your AI coding assistant with memory, security checks, and better habits, so it performs more like a careful senior engineer and less like a fast but careless intern.
buyer: A startup engineering lead whose team leans heavily on AI coding assistants and has been burned by security slip-ups or sloppy, forgetful output.
business_use_cases: An engineering lead installs it across the team's AI coding tools to get built-in security scanning before code ships, instead of relying on a separate paid SAST tool.
A dev agency standardizes every project on it so client codebases get consistent research-first development discipline regardless of which junior developer is driving the AI tool.
A solo SaaS founder uses the persistent memory feature so their AI assistant stops relearning the same project context every session, cutting wasted back-and-forth.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding and configuration of the plugin for teams adopting AI-assisted development at scale.
Sell the hosted Pro tier (private-repo GitHub App) as a reseller or implementation partner for agencies.

steal_this: Install it on your team's AI coding setup this weekend, run it through one real feature branch, and document the security catches it made as a pitch for internal adoption budget.
